works.title: OEIS A164660, final FORMULA (29 May 2016): Chebyshev numerators and floor products
works.abstract: We prove Anthony Browne's conjecture in OEIS A164660, final FORMULA (29 May 2016): for every positive integer n, the reduced numerator of the integral from 0 to 1 of T_(n+1)(x) equals the stated floor product and (-1)^(n/rad(n)). Both sides are +1 exactly when 4 divides n. The same calculation proves the preceding rational-integral conjecture and gives its denominator sequence A164661. More generally, replacing the exponent n in the product by any integer r >= 2, and translating its interval by any integer, leaves the product unchanged. We give the exact root count for every r >= 1 and correct two coefficient-table discrepancies in the linked sources.
works.summary: A self-contained proof of the complete A164660 floor-product identity, with the integral and denominator formulas, the sharp general-exponent root count, translated-interval sign invariance, precise Lean coverage, and coefficient-source corrections. Earlier root-count formulas and Fried's proof of the A000188 square-indicator identity are credited.

problems.name: Anthony Browne's final FORMULA conjecture in OEIS A164660 (29 May 2016)

plain_language.en:
This paper connects integrals of Chebyshev polynomials with products built by rounding numbers down, asking why these different calculations produce the same integer. It proves Browne’s conjectured formula for the numerator after the integral is reduced to lowest terms, and also determines the denominator. The product identity extends to every integer exponent greater than one and remains unchanged under integer translations of its interval.

Why should integrating a polynomial produce a numerator governed by divisibility of integer powers? Start with 1 and x, then repeatedly multiply the current polynomial by 2x and subtract the preceding polynomial. These are the Chebyshev polynomials Tₘ. Integrating each from 0 to 1 gives a rational number. Haobo Ma and Wenlin Zhang explain why its reduced, signed numerator matches a particular product of signs. Their subject is Anthony Browne’s conjecture of 29 May 2016 in OEIS A164660, a sequence introduced by Wolfdieter Lang in 2009.

The authors first evaluate the integral, denoted Iₘ. They obtain I₀=1 and I₁=1/2. For even m≥2 it is −1/(m²−1); when m leaves remainder 1 upon division by 4, it is 1/(m+1); for remainder 3, it is −1/(m−1). These fractions are already reduced, so they determine both numerator and denominator, including the denominator sequence A164661. The mechanism is Tₘ(cos θ)=cos(mθ): substituting x=cos θ turns the integral into one of cos(mθ) sin θ. A trigonometric product identity then reduces everything to endpoint cosines determined by m modulo 4.

For the arithmetic side, the floor of a number means the greatest integer not exceeding it. For positive integers n and r, define F(k)=⌊kʳ/n⌋−⌊(kʳ−1)/n⌋, with subtraction before division. This difference is 1 exactly when n divides kʳ, and otherwise 0. Thus 1−2F(k) is −1 for a divisible power and +1 otherwise. Browne’s product uses r=n and k from 1 through n. The authors prove that it equals the reduced numerator of Iₙ₊₁ and also (−1) raised to n/rad(n). Here rad(n) multiplies the distinct prime divisors, with rad(1)=1. The common value is +1 exactly when 4 divides n, and −1 otherwise, including n=1.

The bridge is counting negative factors. Write n as a product of prime powers pᵉ. For kʳ to contain pᵉ, k must contain at least ⌈e/r⌉ copies of p, where the ceiling rounds upward. Let D multiply these required prime powers. Then n divides kʳ exactly when D divides k, including k=0. Because D divides n, every block of n consecutive integers contains exactly C=n/D such multiples, even across negative integers. The product is therefore (−1)ᶜ. For n>1, C equals n/rad(n) exactly when r reaches the largest prime exponent in n. This sharpens Bottomley’s earlier sufficient bound and recovers Browne’s earlier floor sum and classical root-count formulas.

The count can change without changing its parity. At n=16, exponent 2 requires divisibility by 4, giving four solutions per block; exponent 4 requires only divisibility by 2, giving eight. Both products are +1. Generally, odd prime factors cannot affect parity. If n contains exactly t factors of 2, C contains t−⌈t/r⌉ such factors. For r≥2, this is positive exactly when t≥2. Consequently every exponent r≥2 and every integer translation preserve Browne’s product. The restriction matters: r=1 always gives −1, disagreeing at n=4.

The note also corrects two coefficient-table errors through the rule that integrating a coefficient of xʲ⁻¹ divides it by j. A column multiplier needs an extra factor of 1/2, and an integrated coefficient from T₇ is −56/3, not +56/3. The authors credit prior counting results and Fried’s 2025 proof of Yanev’s square-indicator identity, rather than treating it as new or open. They also acknowledge an earlier complete Lean proof of Browne’s original equalities.

The evidence has distinct scopes. Written proofs cover the integral, arbitrary exponents, translated intervals, and corrections. The manuscript reports that its cited Lean declaration proves Browne’s two equalities for every positive n, using an integral-evaluation lemma for indices at least two; the extensions and initial integrals lie outside that stated formal scope. Exact finite checks cover the original identities through n=300 and generalized cases through n=128, r=12, at six specified shifts; they do not replace unrestricted proofs. The significance is the explicit connection between integration and parity of divisibility counts. Separate sums of reduced coefficient numerators or denominators receive no new closed formulas; the note does not establish that finding them is an open problem.
plain_language.zh:
这篇论文把切比雪夫多项式的积分与向下取整构成的乘积联系起来，解释两种不同计算为何得到同一个整数。作者证明了布朗关于积分约分后分子的猜想，并确定了分母。乘积恒等式还推广到所有大于一的整数指数，而且计算区间作任意整数平移时，乘积保持不变。

为什么多项式积分的分子，会由整数幂的整除性质决定？从1和x出发，每次把当前多项式乘以2x，再减去前一个，便得到切比雪夫多项式Tₘ。将它从0积到1，所得分数约分后的带符号分子，竟等于一个特殊的符号乘积。Ma和Zhang讨论的是Browne于2016年5月29日在OEIS A164660提出的猜想；该数列由Lang于2009年引入。

作者先求积分值，记作Iₘ。初值为I₀=1、I₁=1/2；偶数m≥2时为−1/(m²−1)，m除以4余1时为1/(m+1)，余3时为−1/(m−1)。这些分数均已约分，也就确定了分子和分母，包括分母数列A164661。关键是Tₘ(cos θ)=cos(mθ)：令x=cos θ，原积分化为cos(mθ) sin θ的积分。积化和差后，只需计算端点余弦，其值取决于m除以4的余数。

算术一侧用到向下取整，即取不超过原数的最大整数。对正整数n、r，令F(k)=⌊kʳ/n⌋−⌊(kʳ−1)/n⌋，减1在除法之前。这个差恰在n整除kʳ时为1，其余为0。因此因子1−2F(k)分别为−1或+1。Browne取r=n，让k从1到n相乘。作者证明乘积等于Iₙ₊₁的约分分子，也等于以n/rad(n)为指数的−1的幂；rad(n)是n的不同素因子的乘积，约定rad(1)=1。共同的值恰在4整除n时为+1，其余为−1，n=1也包括在内。

连接两端的是负因子计数。把n分解为素数幂pᵉ；要使kʳ含有pᵉ，k至少须含⌈e/r⌉个p，其中上取整表示向上取到整数。把这些必需的素数幂相乘，记为D，则n整除kʳ等价于D整除k，k=0也成立。由于D整除n，任意连续n个整数中恰有C=n/D个D的倍数，区间包含负整数也一样。乘积于是只看C的奇偶。n>1时，C等于n/rad(n)的充要条件是r达到n的最大素因子指数。这把Bottomley先前的充分界限改为精确门槛，并恢复Browne较早的取整和式及经典求根计数。

计数改变，奇偶却可能不变。n=16、r=2时，k须被4整除，每段有4个解；r=4时只须被2整除，有8个解，乘积均为+1。一般而言，奇素因子不影响奇偶。若n恰含t个因子2，则C含t−⌈t/r⌉个因子2；r≥2时，这个数恰在t≥2时为正。因此任意r≥2、任意整数平移都保持Browne乘积的值。限制不能删去：r=1时乘积恒为−1，在n=4时便不符。

稿件还依据逐项积分时xʲ⁻¹的系数须除以j，纠正两处系数表错误：一个列乘数须再乘1/2，T₇的一个积分系数应为−56/3而非+56/3。作者承认经典计数的先行成果，并指出Yanev的平方指示恒等式已有Fried于2025年的证明，不把它当成新结果或未决问题；也说明Browne原始两个等式已有较早的完整Lean证明。

证据范围须分清：积分、任意指数、平移及修正有书面证明。据稿件说明，所引Lean声明对所有正整数n证明Browne的两个等式，使用适用于下标至少为2的积分求值引理，不涵盖上述推广或初始积分。精确有限检验覆盖原恒等式至n=300，推广至n=128、r=12及六个指定平移，不能代替无限范围的证明。意义在于用整除计数的奇偶性连接积分与取整乘积。逐项约分后分别相加的系数分子、分母数列未获新闭式；稿件也未断言寻找这些闭式是已知的开放问题。

works.title: A counterexample to Bu--Gu--Jaffe's expected mixed-state inverse sumset estimate
works.abstract: We refute the mixed-state inverse sumset estimate expected in Remark 45, equation (58), of Bu, Gu and Jaffe, Quantum Ruzsa Divergence to Quantify Magic (arXiv:2401.14385v3). A computationally diagonal equal mixture of two basis states in dimension seven has quantum-doubling constant sqrt(2) and relative entropy log(7/2) from its mean state, while the proposed bound is at most (1/2)log(7). The contradiction uses exact inequalities and persists for every tensor power. For the same family, we verify that the weaker estimate (59) has a positive denominator and holds strictly, and give the equality case of the companion entropy-growth statement for computationally diagonal states.
works.summary: An exact diagonal seven-dimensional counterexample to the expected mixed-state inverse sumset bound, with tensor-power counterexamples and direct verification of the weaker companion estimate on the same family.

authors.name: Ma, Haobo
authors.affiliation: ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

authors.name: Zhang, Wenlin
authors.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

problems.name: Bu, Gu and Jaffe's mixed-state inverse sumset estimate, Remark 45, equation (58)

plain_language.en:
This paper examines whether limited entropy growth when quantum states are combined forces a mixed state to remain close to its associated mean state. An equal mixture of two basis states in dimension seven disproves the proposed bound, and the contradiction survives every tensor power. The same examples satisfy a weaker proposed estimate, so the counterexample does not invalidate both bounds.

How much structure can be inferred when adding independent random inputs produces little extra uncertainty? Classical inverse sumset theory, including Tao’s entropy formulation, asks this question. Bu, Gu and Jaffe developed a quantum counterpart and proved a bound for pure states. Their expected extension to mixed states—statistical mixtures of pure preparations—is the target here. Haobo Ma and Wenlin Zhang refute that particular quantitative estimate in the third arXiv version of Quantum Ruzsa Divergence to Quantify Magic, not its pure-state theorem.

The example needs only ordinary probabilities. A diagonal state assigns probabilities to chosen basis labels without quantum coherence between them. Here labels are integers modulo seven, with probability one half each at 0 and 1. Quantum convolution combines independent labels I and J into 2I+2J modulo seven, discarding the other output. These coefficients are allowed because 2²+2² equals 1 modulo seven. The four equally likely pairs produce 0, 2, 2, 4: output probabilities one quarter, one half, one quarter. Entropy, measuring uncertainty with natural logarithms, rises from log 2 to (3/2) log 2. The “doubling constant,” the exponential of this increase, is √2.

The comparison object, the “mean state,” retains only characteristic coefficients of absolute value one. These coefficients are expectations of basic phase and shift operators, not arithmetic averages of states. Nonzero shifts have zero expectation here. Phase coefficients have magnitudes |cos(πp/7)|, where p ranges over the seven residues, so only the identity coefficient has magnitude one. Thus the mean is uniform on seven labels. Its rank R is seven, and the relative entropy D to this mean is log 7 minus the original entropy: D = log(7/2). Modest entropy growth therefore coexists with substantial departure from the mean.

The proposed bound also uses purity P, the sum of squared state eigenvalues, and λ, the square of the largest characteristic magnitude strictly between zero and one. It asserts D ≤ (log R) log C / (log R − log[1+λ(RP−1)]) when the doubling constant is above one and at most C. Here P = 1/2 and λ = cos²(π/7). Take C = √2. Even replacing λ by any number between zero and one leaves the denominator at least log 2, making the predicted bound at most (1/2) log 7. But log(7/2) is larger, exactly because 7 > 4. Neither approximation nor a zero denominator causes the contradiction.

Independent copies preserve the failure. For n copies, the mean is uniform on 7ⁿ labels, relative entropy is n log(7/2), and the doubling constant is 2ⁿᐟ². Characteristic coefficients multiply, leaving the largest nonunit magnitude unchanged. The proposed bound is then at most (n/2) log 7. The authors also verify the weaker companion estimate throughout this family: its denominator is positive but smaller than the entropy increase, and its numerator equals the relative entropy. It consequently holds strictly for every permitted C, without establishing it for arbitrary mixed states.

A separate argument classifies zero entropy growth for diagonal states at these parameters. For independent copies X and Y on vectors over the seven-element field, conditioning gives H(2X+2Y) ≥ H(2X+2Y given Y) = H(X). Equality requires identical conditional output laws. The input law must therefore be invariant under translations generated by differences between its support points, forcing it to be uniform on a translate of an additive subgroup. Conversely, these uniform laws preserve entropy. The authors identify them as the diagonal normalized projections onto stabilizer subspaces, consistently with Tao’s classical characterization.

The authors credit the single-system construction to trureturing contributors. Their written proofs cover every positive integer n and the diagonal equality classification. The described exact checker covers single-system calculations and tensor outputs only through eight copies; the reported Lean declaration proves the single-system negation under that file’s definitions, not all these extensions. The significance is a classical obstruction inside a quantum proposal, not a refutation of quantum inverse theory generally. A valid replacement mixed-state bound, the weaker estimate beyond this family, and equality outside the diagonal setting are not settled here.
plain_language.zh:
这篇论文考察：量子态组合时熵的增长有限，是否就能保证混合态接近其对应的平均态。作者用七维空间中两个基态的等权混合推翻了所提界限，而且反例在任意张量幂下仍然成立。不过，同一组例子满足较弱的估计，因此不能据此否定两个界限。

把两个独立随机输入相加，若不确定性只增加一点，能否反推出输入具有特殊结构？经典逆和集理论研究这类问题，陶哲轩也给出了熵的表述。Bu、Gu、Jaffe将其发展到量子情形，并证明了纯态的一个界。Ma与Zhang针对的是其论文《Quantum Ruzsa Divergence to Quantify Magic》第三版预期的混合态推广。混合态允许以概率混合纯态制备；作者否定这个特定定量估计，并未推翻纯态定理。

反例只需普通概率。对角态给选定基底的标签分配概率，没有标签间的量子相干。标签取模七整数，输入在0和1上各有一半概率。量子卷积将独立标签I、J变成2I+2J，舍弃另一个输出；系数合法，因为模七下2²+2²等于1。四个等可能输入对产生0、2、2、4，故输出概率为四分之一、二分之一、四分之一。熵用自然对数衡量不确定性，从log 2升至(3/2) log 2。“倍增常数”是熵增的指数，因此等于√2。

比较对象“均值态”仅保留绝对值为一的特征系数。这些系数是基本相位、移位算符的期望值，并非态的算术平均。本例非零移位的期望均为零；相位系数的模为|cos(πp/7)|，p遍历模七剩余类，只有恒等算符对应的系数模为一。因此均值态在七个标签上均匀，秩R为七。原态到均值态的相对熵D为log 7减去原态熵，即D = log(7/2)。熵增不大，却仍可明显偏离均值态。

预期估计还使用纯度P，即态的各特征值平方之和，以及λ，即模严格介于零和一之间的最大特征系数模的平方。当倍增常数大于一且不超过C时，它声称D ≤ (log R) log C / (log R − log[1+λ(RP−1)])。本例P = 1/2，λ = cos²(π/7)。取C = √2，即使把λ换成零到一之间任意数，分母仍至少为log 2，右侧至多为(1/2) log 7；但log(7/2)更大，恰因为7 > 4。矛盾不依赖近似或分母为零。

取独立副本也不能消除反例。n个副本的均值态在7ⁿ个标签上均匀，相对熵为n log(7/2)，倍增常数为2ⁿᐟ²。特征系数相乘，最大非单位模保持不变，预期上界至多为(n/2) log 7。作者还验证较弱的配套估计在整族上严格成立：其分母为正且小于熵增，分子等于相对熵，所以每个允许的C都使右侧严格大于左侧。这不证明它对任意混合态成立。

另一论证刻画这些参数下对角态何时没有熵增。令X、Y是七元域向量上的独立同分布变量，条件熵给出H(2X+2Y) ≥ H(2X+2Y给定Y) = H(X)。取等要求各条件输出分布一致，迫使输入分布在支撑点之差生成的平移下不变，故必须在某个加法子群的平移上均匀；反之，这些均匀分布确实保持熵不变。作者将其识别为稳定子子空间上归一化投影的对角情形，与陶哲轩的经典刻画一致。

作者将单系统构造归功于trureturing贡献者。书面证明覆盖所有正整数n及对角取等刻画；所述精确检查器只覆盖单系统计算和至多八个副本的输出。所报告的Lean声明仅在该文件定义下证明单系统命题的否定，不涵盖全部推广。本文揭示的是量子提议中的经典障碍，并非否定整个量子逆理论。混合态的有效替代界、较弱估计在本族之外是否成立，以及非对角情形的取等刻画，均未在此解决。

works.title: Refuting the trace-distance case of axiom (T4) of Denis, Lacaille, Martin and Serrano-Ensástiga
works.abstract: We refute the trace-distance case of axiom (T4) of Denis, Lacaille, Martin and Serrano-Ensástiga (arXiv:2605.29436v1, Section III.A.2, Eq. (22) with p=1; (T4) in Section II.B, Eqs. (7)–(8)), where “a proof is left open.” An explicit SU(2)-covariant channel decreases the order-seven anticoherence of a mixed spin-four state by exactly 95/90552, disproving the universal validity suggested by their reported numerical evidence. The channel is a normalized sum of quadrupole Kraus operations; its covariance and trace preservation follow from Cartesian tensor identities. Both reduced states are diagonal, so the strict inequality reduces to rational arithmetic. We reconstruct an existing spin-four witness and give a self-contained exact counterexample within the full mixed-state domain of the proposed axiom.
works.summary: A complete proof reconstructs the attributed mixed-spin trace-distance counterexample. Certified sibling calculations show fidelity anticoherence increases for the same witness at all t=1,...,8; trace anticoherence increases at t=1,...,6,8. Proposition 6 cannot apply generally to trace distance because its total-measure hypothesis fails. Universal fidelity monotonicity, mixed inputs restricted to t<=N/2, pure-input behavior, and minimum spin/order are not settled.

authors.affiliation: ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

problems.name: Denis, Lacaille, Martin and Serrano-Ensastiga's trace-distance case of axiom (T4)

plain_language.en:
This paper tests a proposed measure of how closely a spin state’s reduced states resemble maximally mixed states. For a mixed spin-four state, it constructs a transformation that respects rotations yet decreases the seventh-order trace-distance measure, contrary to the proposed axiom. The decrease is established by exact rational arithmetic, disproving this case of the axiom on its stated mixed-state domain.

Can an operation that treats every spatial direction equally make a quantum spin state less uniform? Denis, Lacaille, Martin and Serrano-Ensástiga proposed that a particular measure of directional uniformity should never decrease under such operations. Their numerical evidence supported this claim, but they left its proof open. Haobo Ma and Wenlin Zhang reconstruct a counterexample involving a mixed spin-four state. It shows why testing many examples cannot establish an inequality quantified over every permitted state and operation.

To define the measure, represent a spin of size j using N = 2j two-level quantum systems, called qubits, restricted to their permutation-symmetric subspace. Retaining t qubits and discarding the others by a partial trace gives a reduced state in a space of dimension t+1. Its maximally mixed state assigns equal probability to every orthogonal basis direction. If D is the unhalved trace norm of the difference from this reference, the proposed order-t anticoherence is A = 1 − D/[2t/(t+1)]. For diagonal states, D is the sum of absolute probability differences. Larger A means greater uniformity. The mixed-state proposal allows every order through N, not just the usual pure-state range t ≤ N/2.

The authors work in the nine-dimensional spin-four space, represented by eight symmetric qubits. Its basis vectors are equal superpositions of bitstrings containing exactly r ones, for r from zero to eight. The input probabilities are (209, 92, 560, 0, 441, 0, 294, 168, 0)/1764. Their channel preserves total probability and positivity even with an auxiliary system attached. They construct it from symmetrized products of angular-momentum operators, subtracting the scalar trace part to obtain quadrupole operators. The channel sums the corresponding operator–state–operator products with factor 3/770. The authors prove normalization because the operator squares sum to 770/3 times the identity. Tensor transformation and rotation-matrix orthogonality establish covariance for every rotation, not merely sampled rotations.

The counterexample then reduces to probability arithmetic. Five equivalent channel operators shift r by at most two, keeping this input and its output diagonal. Discarding one qubit gives retained probabilities (8−k)pₖ/8 + (k+1)pₖ₊₁/8, where pᵣ is the original probability of r ones. The terms correspond to discarding a zero or a one. The input's seven-qubit probabilities become (21, 21, 40, 21, 21, 21, 21, 2)/168. Uniformity would mean eight entries of 21/168, so its distance is 38/168 = 19/84. The authors obtain output distance 3933/17248, larger by 95/51744. Dividing by the normalization 7/4 gives the exact anticoherence change −95/90552, contradicting the proposed inequality.

Why does distance contraction not prevent this? Covariance on the original spin space supplies no contracting channel on the reduced space. A random mixture of rotations would decrease reduced distance: partial trace respects each rotation, and the norm is convex and rotation-invariant. This witness therefore lies outside that subclass. Conversely, at full order t = N, the authors prove monotonicity. Covariance fixes the maximally mixed state, while positivity and trace preservation contract trace norm on Hermitian differences. The failure thus depends on reduction rather than contradicting full-state contraction.

The note credits an existing upstream Lean witness rather than claiming a different example. According to its description, the cited Lean declaration states failure of the mixed-state trace-distance claim. The manuscript supplies a written tensor proof and exact reductions; accompanying finite computations compare this witness at all eight orders. Trace-distance anticoherence increases at orders one through six and eight. A fidelity-based candidate—square the sum of square roots of reduced eigenvalues, subtract one, then divide by t—increases at all eight orders. Integer-square-root bounds certify these signs rather than floating-point estimates. These finite comparisons are not a universal fidelity-monotonicity proof or an extension of the cited Lean declaration's scope.

The result excludes this trace-distance candidate from the proposed universally valid mixed-state framework. A prior conditional construction of a quantum measure cannot generally be applied with it because its hypothesis fails; the conditional proposition itself is not refuted. The proved purity and Hilbert–Schmidt constructions remain unaffected. Open questions include universal fidelity monotonicity, trace-distance monotonicity for mixed states restricted to t ≤ N/2 or for pure inputs, and the smallest spin and order permitting violations. The contribution is a precisely explained counterexample within the stated domain, not a settlement of these neighboring questions.
plain_language.zh:
这篇论文检验一种拟议度量，它衡量自旋态的约化态接近最大混合态的程度。作者针对一个混合的自旋四态，构造了与旋转相容、却使七阶迹距离度量下降的变换，违背所提公理。下降幅度由精确有理数计算确定，从而否定了该公理在其混合态适用范围内的这一情形。

不偏向任何空间方向的操作，会不会使量子自旋态反而更不均匀？Denis、Lacaille、Martin 和 Serrano-Ensástiga 提出，一种衡量方向均匀性的量在此类操作下不应减小。他们的数值证据支持这一主张，但证明尚未完成。Ma 和 Zhang 重构了一个混合自旋四态的反例，说明检验许多例子不能确立对所有允许态和操作成立的不等式。

先把大小为 j 的自旋表示为 N = 2j 个二能级量子系统，即量子比特，并限制在置换对称子空间。保留 t 个比特，对其余部分取偏迹，所得约化态位于维数为 t+1 的空间。最大混合态在任何正交基上赋予相等概率。若 D 是约化态与此参照之差的未除以二的迹范数，所提 t 阶反相干量为 A = 1 − D/[2t/(t+1)]。对角态的 D 就是概率差的绝对值之和；A 越大越均匀。混合态主张允许直到 N 的所有阶数，不能套用纯态通常的 t ≤ N/2 限制。

作者使用九维自旋四空间，即八比特对称空间。基向量是恰有 r 个一的比特串的等权叠加，r 从零到八。输入概率为 (209, 92, 560, 0, 441, 0, 294, 168, 0)/1764。所构造通道保持总概率，且附加辅助系统后仍保持正性。作者将角动量算符乘积对称化、减去标量迹部分，得到四极矩算符，再将“算符—态—算符”乘积求和，乘以 3/770。算符平方和等于单位算符的 770/3 倍，保证归一化；张量变换规律与旋转矩阵的正交性保证对所有旋转协变，而非仅检验有限样本。

关键步骤成为概率运算。通道可改写为五个算符，每个使 r 最多改变二，故此输入与输出都保持对角形式。丢弃一个比特后，保留 k 个一的概率为 (8−k)pₖ/8 + (k+1)pₖ₊₁/8，其中 pᵣ 是原有 r 个一的概率；两项对应丢弃零和一。输入的七比特概率为 (21, 21, 40, 21, 21, 21, 21, 2)/168。均匀时每项为 21/168，故距离是 38/168 = 19/84。作者算得输出距离为 3933/17248，增加 95/51744；再除以归一化因子 7/4，反相干量恰好改变 −95/90552，违反所提不等式。

距离收缩为何没有阻止它？原自旋空间上的协变性，并不提供约化空间上的收缩通道。如果操作只是随机选择旋转，偏迹与各旋转相容，再由范数的凸性和旋转不变性，约化距离必不增加，因此本例不属于这一子类。反之，在不丢弃比特的最高阶 t = N，作者证明单调性成立：协变性固定最大混合态，正性与保迹性使厄米差的迹范数不增。这里的失败依赖约化，并未违背全态的距离收缩。

本文注明沿用上游已有的 Lean 见证，而非另一个例子。按附带说明，该 Lean 声明断言混合态迹距离主张失败。本文给出书面的张量证明和精确约化，配套有限计算比较同一见证的全部八阶：迹距离量在一至六阶及八阶增加。另一保真度候选量将约化态特征值的平方根求和、平方、减一，再除以 t；它在八阶都增加。整数平方根界严格确定这些符号，并非浮点估计。这些有限比较既不是保真度普遍单调性的证明，也没有扩大所引 Lean 声明的范围。

结果排除了该迹距离候选量在整个混合态范围内满足所提框架的可能。先前构造量子部分的条件命题，因前提失效而不能普遍用于此量；条件命题本身未被推翻。已证明的纯度与 Hilbert–Schmidt 构造也不受影响。保真度的普遍单调性、限制在 t ≤ N/2 的混合态或纯输入的迹距离单调性，以及发生违反所需的最小自旋与阶数，仍未解决。本文给出的是适用范围明确、可精确解释的反例，而非这些相邻问题的全面答案。

works.title: Reflection-symmetric diagonal synthesis: resolving a conjecture of Huang, Kosugi, Nishi and Matsushita
works.abstract: Combined with the upper bound of Huang, Kosugi, Nishi and Matsushita [J. Phys. Soc. Jpn. 93, 054002 (2024); arXiv:2310.06676v2], this resolves their Section 6 conjecture that 2^(2n-1)+2n-2 CNOTs are optimal in the worst case for exact ancilla-free CNOT/R_z synthesis of reflection-symmetric diagonal unitaries on 2n qubits. The explicit hard instance has phase pi/2 at the all-zero and all-one strings. Multiplicative characters force every nonzero even parity; birth-span dimension and return conservation give the linear term. The same substitution gives the unrestricted 2dn-wire count, but not depth optimality or radial-potential optimality.
works.summary: Self-contained exposition of the pinned upstream lower-bound proof resolving the Section 6 conjecture of Huang, Kosugi, Nishi and Matsushita when combined with their matching synthesis algorithm. Includes exact finite checks and a precise distinction between the unrestricted higher-dimensional count and the remaining depth and radial-potential questions.

problems.name: Huang, Kosugi, Nishi and Matsushita's worst-case CNOT count conjecture in Section 6

plain_language.en:
This paper asks how many controlled-NOT gates are needed to implement diagonal quantum operations that assign identical phases to complementary binary strings. It constructs an operation that requires as many such gates as an existing general construction uses, settling the conjectured worst-case count for exact circuits using only controlled-NOT gates and single-qubit phase rotations, without auxiliary qubits. It does not establish optimal circuit depth.

A quantum operation may leave every binary basis string unchanged while multiplying its amplitude by a complex phase factor of magnitude one. Such an operation is a diagonal unitary. Suppose complementary strings, obtained by flipping every bit, receive identical phases. How many controlled-NOT gates, or CNOTs, are needed to implement it? This reflection-symmetry problem asks whether economical constructions are already optimal in the worst case. Only CNOTs are counted, not single-qubit rotations.

Haobo Ma and Wenlin Zhang consider m = 2n qubits, where n is a positive integer. Circuits must be finite and exact, use no auxiliary qubits, and contain only CNOTs and rotations about the z axis, called R_z rotations, with arbitrary real angles. Overall phase is ignored. Their hard target multiplies the all-zero and all-one strings by i and leaves the others unchanged. They establish a lower bound of 2^(m−1)+m−2 CNOTs. Huang, Kosugi, Nishi and Matsushita previously constructed circuits meeting this bound for every target in the class; the matching lower bound settles their worst-case conjecture. The note explicitly expounds a proof already present in the cited Trureturing formalization.

The proof tracks which input bits each wire currently combines. A CNOT replaces its target bit by the exclusive-or of target and control. Every wire therefore holds the parity, or sum modulo two, of an input subset; its label records that subset. This uses the parity-network viewpoint of Amy, Azimzadeh and Mosca. For two qubits, one CNOT creates their combined parity. Applying R_z with angle −π/2 on that wire and then repeating the CNOT realizes the hard target up to overall phase, using exactly two CNOTs. Generally, a diagonal circuit must restore all original bits, because rotations never change basis strings.

To force particular labels, fix a nonempty subset. Multiply the circuit’s phase factors over inputs where this subset has even parity, and divide by the product over inputs where it has odd parity. This multiplicative test avoids choosing phase angles modulo 2π. Overall phase cancels. A rotation depending on any different nonempty subset also cancels: inputs can be paired so its wire value stays fixed while the test parity flips. For the hard target, however, every nonempty subset of even size gives −1, because both marked inputs contribute i in the numerator. Thus every such subset must occur on a rotated wire. There are 2^(m−1)−1 required labels.

Counting labels alone misses restoration costs. Call a label even when its subset has even size; initially all labels are odd. Each required even label first appears as a CNOT output, already requiring 2^(m−1)−1 gates. An update with odd target and odd control is called a birth. Every even label ever produced lies in the span of birth outputs under addition modulo two: combining existing even labels stays in that span, while mixed-parity updates produce odd labels. The space of even labels has dimension m−1, so at least m−1 births are needed. Each birth increases the number of currently even wires by one. Returning to the initial labels requires equally many updates decreasing that number. These restoration updates have odd outputs, so they add at least m−1 gates beyond those already counted.

The evidence has distinct scopes. The manuscript gives a written proof for every positive n. Exact-arithmetic computations check the phase identity and multiplicative tests for m = 2, 4, 6, 8. Exhaustive searches establish shortest identity-return networks of lengths 2 and 10 only for m = 2 and 4. These are finite corroborations, not enumeration for all sizes. The supplied Lean snapshots concern the lower bound and its counting component; worst-case equality additionally relies on the literature upper bound.

The result determines the largest minimum CNOT count in this symmetry class, not every target’s cost: the identity needs none. For positive integers d and n, substitution gives 2^(2dn−1)+2dn−2 on 2dn wires, including the full complement-symmetric class on 6n wires. It does not settle Huang and colleagues’ narrower, radially symmetric interaction-potential family. Optimal depth also remains unresolved, since disjoint gates can run simultaneously. Auxiliary qubits, approximation, and other gate sets fall outside the theorem.
plain_language.zh:
这篇论文研究：对互补二进制串赋予相同相位的对角量子操作，需要多少个受控非门。作者构造了一个实例，其所需门数达到已有通用构造的上界，解决了仅用受控非门和单量子比特相位旋转、且不借助辅助量子比特时的精确实现最坏门数猜想。这并不证明电路深度最优。

一个量子操作可以不改变任何二进制基态串，只给其振幅乘上模长为一的复数，即相位因子；这叫对角酉变换。若互为逐位取反的两个串必须获得相同相位，实现它需要多少受控非门，简称CNOT？这就是文中的反射对称性问题：已有的省门构造是否已经达到最坏情况下的最优成本？这里只计算CNOT，不计算单比特旋转。

Ma和Zhang考虑m = 2n个量子比特，n为正整数。电路必须有限、精确、不用辅助比特，且只含CNOT与任意实数角度的绕z轴旋转R_z；整体相位不计。他们的困难目标只给全零串和全一串乘上i，其余不变，并证明至少需要2^(m−1)+m−2个CNOT。Huang、Kosugi、Nishi和Matsushita此前已为整类目标构造了达到此数目的电路；匹配的下界解决了他们的最坏情形猜想。本文明确是在阐述已见于所引Trureturing形式化中的证明。

证明跟踪每条线路当前组合了哪些输入位。CNOT把目标位替换为它与控制位的异或，因此每条线路始终保存某个输入子集的奇偶值，即模二之和；标签记录这个子集。这沿用了Amy、Azimzadeh和Mosca的奇偶网络观点。两比特时，先用一个CNOT生成两位异或，在该线路施加角度−π/2的R_z，再重复同一个CNOT，就能在相差整体相位的意义下实现困难目标，恰用两个CNOT。一般而言，旋转不改变基态串，所以对角电路最终必须恢复所有原始输入位。

为迫使特定标签出现，先固定一个非空子集，把其奇偶值为零的所有输入所获相位因子相乘，再除以奇偶值为一者的乘积。这个乘法检验不必选择模2π的相位角。整体相位会抵消；依赖其他非空子集的旋转也会抵消，因为可以将输入配对，使旋转所见的位值不变，而检验的奇偶值翻转。但对困难目标，每个大小为偶数的非空子集都给出−1，因为两个特殊输入均在分子中贡献i。因此，每个这样的子集都必须曾作为接受旋转的线路标签，共有2^(m−1)−1个。

仅数标签还漏掉恢复线路的成本。按子集大小把标签分为奇、偶；初始标签全为奇。每个必需的偶标签首次出现都靠一次CNOT输出，已需2^(m−1)−1个门。作者把目标与控制标签均为奇的更新称为“诞生”。所有曾产生的偶标签都在诞生输出的模二线性张成空间内：已有偶标签相加仍在其中，奇偶混合则输出奇标签。全部偶标签的空间维数为m−1，故至少需要m−1次诞生。每次诞生增加一条当前为偶的线路；恢复初始标签则须有同样多次更新减少偶线路。这些恢复更新输出奇标签，因此要在已数的门之外再加至少m−1个。

不同证据的范围不能混淆。文中书面证明涵盖所有正整数n。精确算术计算只在m = 2、4、6、8核对相位恒等式与乘法检验；穷举搜索只在m = 2、4确定恢复恒等映射的最短网络，长度分别为2、10。这些是有限佐证，不是对所有规模的枚举。随附Lean源码快照涉及下界及其计数组件；最坏情形的等式仍依赖文献上界。

结果确定的是此对称类中各目标最少CNOT数的最大值，并非每个目标的成本：恒等操作一个也不用。对正整数d、n，代入可得2dn条线路上的计数2^(2dn−1)+2dn−2，也涵盖6n条线路上的完整逐位取反对称类。但这没有解决Huang等人讨论的、带径向对称限制的相互作用势函数族。最优深度也仍未确定，因为不相交的门可以并行。辅助比特、近似实现及其他门集均不在定理范围内。

works.title: A negative answer to Kang–Jäger's Question 1.10 on permutative lifts
works.abstract: We answer Kang–Jäger's Question 1.10 (arXiv:2609.01140v1) negatively, including its strictly ergodic and Toeplitz versions. We construct one aperiodic regular Toeplitz subshift over the binary alphabet such that, for every permutative block code of every length ell >= 2, the entire inverse image is conjugate over the base to the product with the identity on 2^(ell-1) points. Each lift therefore has exactly 2^(ell-1) clopen strictly ergodic components. The construction uses recognizable equal-length words with factorial repetition counts: these annihilate every finite permutation action, while the proportion of columns on which the two words differ is exactly 3^(-n).
works.summary: One fixed binary regular Toeplitz strictly ergodic base has nonminimal complete inverse images for every bipermutative sliding block code of every length at least two; the exact component count is 2^(ell-1).

authors.name: Ma, Haobo
authors.affiliation: ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

authors.name: Zhang, Wenlin
authors.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

problems.name: Kang and Jaeger's Question 1.10 on permutative lifts

plain_language.en:
This paper asks whether taking all symbolic sequences that map into a highly regular dynamical system under a permutative local rule preserves a single indecomposable system. It constructs one nonperiodic binary Toeplitz system for which every such rule of length at least two instead produces finitely many separate copies of the original dynamics. This answers Kang and Jäger’s question negatively, including its more restrictive versions.

Take a closed family of binary sequences extending infinitely in both directions, with time advancing by shifting one place. Given a local encoding rule, can the family of all inputs producing allowed outputs remain dynamically indivisible? A closed, shift-invariant family is a subshift. It is minimal if every orbit is dense, and strictly ergodic if, additionally, it has exactly one shift-invariant probability measure. Haobo Ma and Wenlin Zhang address Kang and Jäger’s question about whether suitable local rules can preserve these properties when taking all preimages.

A rule reads a window of length ℓ and outputs one bit. It is bipermutative if either endpoint determines the output bijectively when the other entries are fixed. Applying it at every position encodes an entire sequence. The lift contains every sequence whose encoding belongs to the base, not a selected component. The authors construct one binary base whose lift splits into exactly 2^(ℓ−1) copies of the base for every such rule and every ℓ ≥ 2. Kang and Jäger previously found a bad base for each fixed rule, and a bad rule for each Toeplitz base. One base defeating all rules changes the quantifiers decisively.

The construction starts with U₀ = 0 and V₀ = 1. At stage n, put m = (n+1)!, concatenate 2m copies of Uₙ followed by m copies of Vₙ to obtain Uₙ₊₁, and exchange the multiplicities to obtain Vₙ₊₁. Thus U₁ = 001 and V₁ = 011. Keep the sequences admitting such word decompositions at every stage. Boundaries are recognizable: initially, 10 occurs exactly between words; subsequently, the corresponding transition between smaller-word types identifies larger-word boundaries. Different run lengths distinguish the two types.

Write Hₙ for their common length. Recognizability determines the origin’s position within its current word. Shifting advances this position by one, so a global period would have to be divisible by every Hₙ, an impossibility. Every adjacent pair of stage-n types occurs inside every stage-(n+2) word, making every allowed finite pattern recur with bounded gaps and proving minimality. Meanwhile, the two stage-n words disagree in exactly a fraction 3^(−n) of positions. An aligned limiting sequence has each coordinate repeating periodically, without a common period for the whole sequence: the Toeplitz property. Its periodically determined positions have density tending to one, making it regular.

Shrinking disagreement also proves unique ergodicity. Every invariant probability gives equal mass to the Hₙ possible positions within words. A pattern occupying r consecutive coordinates encounters disagreement columns for at most a fraction r·3^(−n) of these positions. Elsewhere, its occurrence is determined independently of the word types. Two invariant probabilities therefore differ on its occurrence event by at most r·3^(−n). Letting n increase forces equality on every finite pattern, hence equality of the measures. The base thus satisfies the question’s strongest hypotheses.

For decoding, record the ℓ−1 input bits needed to continue. Each output bit updates this finite state by a permutation: right-end invertibility determines the next input bit, and left-end invertibility permits reversal. More generally, assign arbitrary permutations to the two letters. On d states, every permutation’s order divides d!, so sufficiently high factorial repetitions make either construction word’s total update the identity, without requiring commutativity. Relabel states using the accumulated update before the origin within its recognizable word. This cancels each update, including across boundaries. The continuous, continuously invertible relabeling leaves the encoded sequence unchanged: the dynamics becomes the base shift together with a finite label that never changes.

Consequently, the authors obtain exactly 2^(ℓ−1) minimal components, each open and closed and strictly ergodic. Invariant probabilities are mixtures of their unique measures, so the entire lift is neither minimal nor uniquely ergodic. Written proofs establish this decomposition. Reported exact computations check words through level four and all binary bipermutative rules of lengths two through five; they do not prove the infinite theorem. Two reported Lean declarations negate the general minimal-existence assertion and its regular-Toeplitz strictly ergodic branch, respectively, rather than certify the full decomposition. The authors credit Kang–Jäger and Hedlund for the finite-state framework, and Berthé and coauthors for the relabeling obstruction. Their counterexample settles the universal existence alternatives negatively, including the Toeplitz versions; it leaves earlier positive results intact and does not classify which other bases admit successful lifts.
plain_language.zh:
这篇论文考察：在置换型局部规则下，取所有映入一个高度规则动力系统的符号序列，是否仍得到不可分解的系统。作者构造了一个非周期二元托普利茨系统，使每个长度至少为二的这类规则所得的原像，都分裂成原系统的有限多个独立副本。这否定了康与耶格的问题，也涵盖其更严格的版本。

设想一族向左右无限延伸的二进制序列，时间前进一步就平移一格。给定局部编码规则，所有编码结果落在这一族中的输入序列，还能保持动力学上的不可分割性吗？对平移封闭且在极限下封闭的序列族叫子移位；每条轨道稠密叫极小，再加上只有一个平移不变概率测度，就叫严格遍历。Haobo Ma 与 Wenlin Zhang 研究的是 Kang 与 Jäger 的问题：能否选择合适的局部规则，使取全部原像仍保有这些性质？

规则读取长度为 ℓ 的窗口并输出一位。固定其他位置后，任一端点与输出都一一对应，这叫双端置换性。逐位应用规则便编码整条序列；基底的提升包含编码落入基底的全部序列，而非挑选的分支。作者构造同一个二进制基底，使每个 ℓ ≥ 2、每种此类规则的提升都分成恰好 2^(ℓ−1) 个基底副本。Kang 与 Jäger 此前已为每种固定规则找到不良基底，也为每个 Toeplitz 基底找到不良规则。本文的关键加强是一个基底同时阻断所有规则，改变了量词次序。

构造从 U₀ = 0、V₀ = 1 开始。第 n 步令 m = (n+1)!，把 2m 个 Uₙ 接上 m 个 Vₙ 得到 Uₙ₊₁，交换重复次数得到 Vₙ₊₁。因此 U₁ = 001、V₁ = 011。只保留每层都能如此分词的序列。词边界可以识别：第一层的 10 恰在词之间出现；以后，小词类型序列中相应的转折标出大词边界，不同连续段长度区分两种大词。

记共同词长为 Hₙ。可识别性确定原点在当前词中的位置，平移使它加一，因此全局周期必须被所有 Hₙ 整除，这是不可能的。任意一对相邻的第 n 层词类型都出现在每个第 n+2 层词内，故每个允许图案都以有界间隔重现，保证极小性。两种第 n 层词不同的位置恰占 3^(−n)。选择各层边界对齐的极限序列，每个坐标各自周期重复，整条序列却无共同周期，这就是 Toeplitz 性质。周期确定的位置密度趋于一，称为正则。

差异比例趋零也保证唯一遍历性。每个不变概率都给 Hₙ 个词内位置相同质量。一个占据连续 r 个坐标的图案，遇到差异列的位置比例至多为 r·3^(−n)；其余位置上的出现与否不依赖词的类型。因此两个不变概率对该图案出现事件所赋概率之差不超过此数。令 n 增大，它们在每个有限图案上相同，因而是同一测度。基底确实满足问题最强的假设。

解码时，记录继续解码所需的 ℓ−1 个输入位，便得到有限状态。每个输出位按置换更新状态：右端可逆性确定下一输入位，左端可逆性允许倒推。更一般地，可给两个字母任意指定置换。在 d 个状态上，每个置换的阶都整除 d!，所以层数足够高时，阶乘重复使任一种构造词的总更新成为恒等，无须两个置换交换。用当前词内原点之前累积的更新重新标记状态，就能抵消每步更新，词边界处也能接合。这种连续且逆映射连续的重标记不改变编码序列；动力学遂成为基底平移加上永不改变的有限标签。

作者由此得到恰好 2^(ℓ−1) 个既开又闭、各自严格遍历的极小分支。不变概率是各分支唯一测度的混合，故全提升既不极小，也不唯一遍历。完整分解有书面证明。所报告的精确计算只检查到第四层词，以及长度二至五的全部二进制双端置换规则，并不证明无限定理。文中报告的两项 Lean 声明分别否定一般极小存在命题及其正则 Toeplitz 严格遍历分支，并非认证完整分解。有限状态框架归功于 Kang–Jäger 和 Hedlund，重标记形成障碍的机制归功于 Berthé 等人。该反例否定了包括 Toeplitz 版本在内的普遍存在命题，但保留此前的正面结果，也未分类哪些其他基底允许良好提升。

works.title: Proof of Mathar's conjecture on OEIS A027182: a closed form and the six-term recurrence
works.abstract: We prove the recurrence for A027182 stated as a conjecture by R. J. Mathar (OEIS A027182, FORMULA section, 6 May 2026) for all n >= 6, by evaluating the middle coefficient of the square of each A027170 row polynomial. Row symmetry reduces the convolution to five binomial sums, and a shifted second-order recurrence gives the six-term recurrence. The same central-binomial identity proves Mathar's conjectured recurrences for A027171, A027174 and A027175; a parity decomposition also proves his seven-term recurrence for the half-row sums A027179.
works.summary: A complete elementary proof of the A027182 conjecture, with corollaries proving the A027171, A027174, A027175 and A027179 conjectures from central-binomial identities and row symmetry.

problems.name: R. J. Mathar's recurrence conjecture for OEIS A027182 (6 May 2026)

plain_language.en:
This paper studies how a sequence derived from rows of a numerical triangle can be calculated from its earlier values. By evaluating the middle coefficient after a row polynomial is squared, it proves Mathar’s conjectured six-term recurrence throughout the stated range. The same calculation also establishes related recurrence conjectures for three companion sequences and, after separating even and odd terms, for half-row sums.

Start with a triangular array built from Pascal’s triangle. Write C(r,k) for the number of ways to choose k objects from r. Row n has entries T(n,k)=2C(n+2,k+1)+C(n,k)−4, for k from 0 to n. Make these the coefficients of a polynomial, square it, and call the coefficient of xⁿ aₙ. This adds products of entries equally far from opposite ends. Can these increasingly long sums obey a fixed rule using only a few earlier answers? Such a recurrence would avoid calculating every new row. For example, row 2 is 5,10,5, giving a₂=5²+10²+5²=150. The authors identify 120 in an OEIS example as a misprint; its term list agrees with 150.

Haobo Ma and Wenlin Zhang give an explicit expression for every n≥0 and derive the recurrence conjectured by R. J. Mathar on 6 May 2026 for Clark Kimberling’s sequence A027182. Let cₘ=C(2m,m), the middle entry of Pascal’s row 2m, called a central binomial coefficient. Their formula is aₙ=4cₙ₊₂+4cₙ₊₁+cₙ−72·2ⁿ+16n+40. Mathar’s six-term relation connects aₙ through aₙ₋₅ with coefficients linear in n and an additional linear correction. The authors establish it for every n≥6. The coefficient of aₙ is 2(n+2), so the preceding five values determine it. The original indexing starts at 1; extending it by a₀=1 also makes the relation valid at n=5.

The key is row symmetry: reversing a row changes nothing. The middle coefficient of the squared polynomial therefore becomes the sum of the squares of its entries. Put Aₖ=C(n+2,k+1) and Bₖ=C(n,k). Expanding (2Aₖ+Bₖ−4)² leaves five nonconstant sums: those of Aₖ², AₖBₖ, Bₖ², Aₖ and Bₖ. Multiplying binomial expansions evaluates the first three: choosing separately from two groups is equivalent to choosing from their union. Summing Pascal rows evaluates the other two. The Aₖ range excludes two endpoint entries, making its squared sum cₙ₊₂−2 rather than cₙ₊₂. Combining these endpoint adjustments and the constant contribution gives the formula. Thus symmetry explains the example and every subsequent row.

For the recurrence, the authors split the formula into a central-binomial part, a power-of-two part, and a linear polynomial. Factorials give (m+1)cₘ₊₁=2(2m+1)cₘ. Combining shifted copies yields a second-order relation for the central-binomial part. Applying this relation to 2ᵐ produces a linear polynomial times 2ᵐ; applying it to the polynomial part produces a quadratic. A shift advances both the index and every index-dependent coefficient. Twice applying “shift minus twice the original,” followed by “shift minus the original,” eliminates the exponential contribution. The quadratic leaves an explicitly computable linear remainder. Expanding the combined operation yields precisely the six sequence terms and correction in Mathar’s conjecture.

The authors also give written proofs of four companion conjectures of Mathar. A027171 takes T(2n,n), A027175 takes T(2n−1,n−1), and A027174 takes T(2n,n−2); their recurrences hold respectively for n≥2, n≥3 and n≥4. These deductions use Christian Krause’s previously recorded explicit formulas. A027179 sums from a row’s left endpoint through its middle, with a seven-term recurrence for n≥6. Symmetry gives half the total in odd rows, but half the total plus half the central entry in even rows. Using the row-total formula credited to Ralf Stephan and Krause, the authors isolate elementary terms and a central-binomial contribution supported only at even indices. Separating even and odd indices reduces the remaining recurrence to explicit polynomial identities.

The significance is a shared elementary explanation of five particular recurrences, not a theory of arbitrary binomial arrays. The manuscript presents written arguments for all stated indices. Separate Python checks through n=400 provide finite corroboration; exact polynomial computations check the displayed algebraic certificates. The manuscript also identifies a pinned Lean declaration stating the main A027182 recurrence for n≥6, not corresponding Lean evidence for the companions. These evidence types and scopes must remain distinct. The note specifies no further open conjecture or application: its stated endpoint is these five recurrences, preserving credit for earlier explicit formulas and row-sum results.
plain_language.zh:
这篇论文研究如何利用先前的数值，计算一个由数值三角形各行导出的数列。作者求出行多项式平方后的中间系数，证明了马瑟猜想的六项递推关系在所述范围内成立。同一计算还证明了三个相关数列的递推猜想，并通过分开奇偶项，证明了半行和的递推猜想。

从帕斯卡三角形构造一个新数表。用 C(r,k) 表示从 r 个对象中选出 k 个的方法数，第 n 行的第 k 项为 T(n,k)=2C(n+2,k+1)+C(n,k)−4，其中 k 从 0 到 n。把这些数作为多项式的系数，将多项式平方，取 xⁿ 的系数，记为 aₙ，即把距两端相同位置的数相乘后求和。问题是：这些越来越长的和，能否只用固定条数的先前结果递推，而不必逐行重算？例如第 2 行是 5、10、5，故 a₂=5²+10²+5²=150。作者指出 OEIS 的一个例子误印为 120，但其数列正文给的是 150。

Haobo Ma 与 Wenlin Zhang 给出所有 n≥0 的显式公式，并由此推导 R. J. Mathar 于 2026 年 5 月 6 日对 Clark Kimberling 的数列 A027182 提出的递推猜想。令 cₘ=C(2m,m)，即帕斯卡三角形第 2m 行的中间项，称为中心二项式系数，则 aₙ=4cₙ₊₂+4cₙ₊₁+cₙ−72·2ⁿ+16n+40。六项递推连接 aₙ 至 aₙ₋₅，系数随 n 线性变化，另有线性修正项。作者证明它对所有 n≥6 成立。aₙ 的系数为 2(n+2)，故前五项能确定当前项。原数列从 1 开始；补入 a₀=1 后，递推在 n=5 也成立。

关键是每行左右对称，所以平方多项式的中间系数就是该行各项的平方和。令 Aₖ=C(n+2,k+1)、Bₖ=C(n,k)，展开 (2Aₖ+Bₖ−4)²，除常数外只需计算 Aₖ²、AₖBₖ、Bₖ²、Aₖ、Bₖ 的五个和。前三个和来自二项式展开式相乘：从两组中分别选择，等于从其并集中选择。后两个和由帕斯卡行求和得到。Aₖ 的范围少了两端各一个数，故平方和是 cₙ₊₂−2，而非 cₙ₊₂。合并端点修正和常数贡献，就得到显式公式。因此，小例子中的对称性适用于每一行。

为推导递推，作者把公式拆成中心二项式部分、二次幂部分和一次多项式。阶乘给出 (m+1)cₘ₊₁=2(2m+1)cₘ；组合其移位，得到第一部分的二阶关系。同一运算作用于 2ᵐ，产生一次多项式乘 2ᵐ；作用于多项式部分，则产生二次多项式。“移位”须让下标和依赖下标的系数一起前进。再连续两次取“移位减去原式的两倍”，随后取一次“移位减去原式”，便消去指数部分，二次多项式则留下可算出的一次余项。展开组合运算，就得到猜想中的六项及修正项。

作者还书面证明 Mathar 的四个伴随猜想。A027171 取 T(2n,n)，A027175 取 T(2n−1,n−1)，A027174 取 T(2n,n−2)；对应递推分别从 n≥2、n≥3、n≥4 成立，所用显式公式归功于 Christian Krause。A027179 从左端加到中间，其七项递推对 n≥6 成立。奇数行的半行和是总和一半，偶数行还须加上中间项的一半。借助归功于 Ralf Stephan 与 Krause 的行总和公式，作者分离初等项与仅在偶数下标非零的中心二项式部分；分奇偶处理后，剩余递推化为明确的多项式恒等式。

意义在于用共同的初等机制解释五个特定递推，而非建立任意二项式数表的通论。文稿给出所述范围内的全下标书面论证。另行至 n=400 的 Python 检查只是有限佐证；精确多项式计算检验所展示的代数恒等式。文稿另指向固定版本的 Lean 声明，陈述 A027182 在 n≥6 时的主递推，并非四个伴随结论的相应 Lean 证据。这些证据的性质与范围不可混同。文章没有另列未解猜想或应用，其目标止于这五项递推，并保留对先前显式公式及行总和工作的归属。

works.title: OEIS A391810: formula (5), COMMENTS (C.1)--(C.10), and prime-index vanishing
works.abstract: We prove formula (5), COMMENTS (C.1)--(C.10), and the zero clause of COMMENT (C.11) of Paul D. Hanna's OEIS entry A391810, revision 39. For n>=1, the original bilateral Laurent coefficients form a finite row polynomial P_n(y)=-1+sum(h=1..n)y^h(1-y^h)^(n-h). Evaluating it at -1 gives the negative alternating row sum 2 round(2^n/3)=2J_n. The same polynomial proves formulas (2), (3), (4), and (6). Its divisor-sum coefficient expression proves the ten individual-term formulas and T(n,q)=0 for every prime q>n. The further first-zero assertion of (C.11) remains open in this note.
works.summary: Complete written proofs of A391810 formulas (2)--(6), COMMENTS (C.1)--(C.10), and prime-index vanishing, with a divisor formula, exact source-item coverage, and finite checks through row 79. The first-zero assertion in (C.11) remains open here.

problems.name: Paul D. Hanna's alternating-sum formula (5) in OEIS A391810, revision 39

plain_language.en:
This paper studies the entries and alternating row sums of Hanna’s numerical array, replacing its two-sided coefficient description with a finite polynomial for each row. That representation proves that the negative alternating row sum equals twice a Jacobsthal number and establishes several entry formulas. It also proves vanishing at prime column indices larger than the row index, while leaving the further first-zero assertion open.

Fix a positive integer n and collect the coefficients of 1, x⁻¹, x⁻², and so on in a two-sided infinite algebraic sum: its term indexed by an integer j is xʲ(1−xʲ)ⁿ⁺ʲ. Call the coefficient of x⁻ᵏ T(n,k). These coefficients form a row of Paul D. Hanna’s integer array A391810 in the On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences. Why should alternating signs across such a row produce a familiar recurrence sequence? Haobo Ma and Wenlin Zhang address this question and related conjectures in revision 39 of Hanna’s entry.

The infinite expression is formal: coefficients are collected algebraically, without assigning x a numerical value. Negative outer exponents mean reciprocals, expanded formally about zero. Each coefficient receives only finitely many contributions, because the lowest powers in the summands eventually increase without bound in both index directions. The authors isolate all nonpositive powers. Positive j contributes none. Writing j=−h, the indices 1≤h≤n give finite polynomials in y=x⁻¹; h=n+1 contributes exactly the constant −1 to this part; larger h contributes nothing. Thus the row is encoded by Pₙ(y)=−1+∑ₕ₌₁ⁿ yʰ(1−yʰ)ⁿ⁻ʰ: T(n,k) is its coefficient of yᵏ.

All coefficients beyond Bₙ vanish, where Bₙ is the square of the integer part of (n+1)/2. For odd n, bounding each summand’s degree suffices. For even n, apparently higher terms cancel: pairing h with n+1−h gives equal highest powers with opposite signs. For example, n=2 gives P₂(y)=−1+y(1−y)+y²=−1+y. Its complete row is therefore −1,1, and negating its alternating sum gives 2. Cancellation, not simple truncation, explains the sharper endpoint.

Alternating a polynomial’s coefficients means evaluating it at −1. This is a finite evaluation, not substitution into the original infinite expression. Here odd h contributes −2ⁿ⁻ʰ, while even h contributes zero unless h=n, when it contributes 1. Summing geometric series separately for odd and even n gives −Pₙ(−1)=2(2ⁿ−(−1)ⁿ)/3. The Jacobsthal numbers start J₀=0, J₁=1 and satisfy Jₙ₊₂=Jₙ₊₁+2Jₙ. Their already-known closed form identifies this value as 2Jₙ. Since Jₙ differs from 2ⁿ/3 by exactly one third, it is the nearest integer to that number. The contribution is the connection to Hanna’s coefficients, not a new Jacobsthal formula. The row theorem requires n≥1.

Expanding each summand explains individual entries. A power yᵏ can occur in the h-th summand only when h divides k; its contribution is the binomial coefficient choosing k/h−1 objects from n−h, with sign (−1)ᵏ⁄ʰ⁻¹. Out-of-range choices count as zero. Summing over divisors h≤n yields the authors’ coefficient formula and Hanna’s ten conjectured individual-entry formulas. For an odd prime p, divisors 1 and p each contribute 1, giving T(p,p)=2. For any prime q>n, only divisor 1 is permitted, but its binomial coefficient is zero: T(n,q)=0.

The polynomial establishes other row identities. Evaluation at 1 gives total sum zero. Applying y times differentiation multiplies each coefficient by its index; evaluating once and twice at 1 gives ∑kT(n,k)=1 and ∑k²T(n,k)=5−2n, the latter for n≥2. Only summands with sufficiently small powers of 1−yʰ survive. Differentiation at −1 yields the alternating index-weighted sums. Storing these sums as coefficients of a power series gives their generating function; separating odd and even h and summing geometric series expresses it as a ratio of polynomials. These are written arguments, not extrapolations from sample rows.

The note reports finite exact-arithmetic checks of rows 1–79 and the scalar Jacobsthal identity through n=512. These supplement the universal written proofs; they cannot establish a claim for all rows. Its supplied Lean source snapshots concern the alternating-sum theorem, coefficient bridge and support bound, row sum, and first two moments; they do not supply formalizations of the divisor formula, prime vanishing, or alternating weighted generating function. Crucially, vanishing at the next prime does not prove it is the first zero: for n≥5, the claim that every earlier entry is nonzero remains open here, despite agreement in rows 5–79. Two other bilateral identities in Hanna’s comments are also outside scope. The advance is a common finite-polynomial explanation of several conjectures, with that first-zero question explicitly unresolved.
plain_language.zh:
这篇论文研究汉纳数表中的各项及交错行和，把原来的双向系数描述改写成每行一个有限多项式。由此证明，交错行和取负后等于雅各布斯塔尔数的两倍，并得到多条单项公式。作者还证明，素数列号大于行号时相应项为零，但关于首个零项位置的进一步断言仍未解决。

固定正整数 n，把一个双向无穷代数和中 1、x⁻¹、x⁻² 等项的系数依次排成一行。这个和按所有整数 j 编号，第 j 项是 xʲ(1−xʲ)ⁿ⁺ʲ，x⁻ᵏ 的系数记作 T(n,k)。这些行组成 Paul D. Hanna 在《整数数列线上百科全书》中提出的数组 A391810。这样定义的系数为何会在交替加减后产生熟悉的递推数列？Haobo Ma 和 Wenlin Zhang 研究了该条目第39版中的这个问题及相关猜想。

这里的无穷和是形式运算：只按幂次收集系数，不给 x 赋数值。负的外层指数表示取倒数，并按 x 在零附近的幂次形式展开。两端指标足够大时，各项的最低幂次都不断升高，因此每个系数只接收有限项的贡献。作者分离所有非正幂：j 为正时没有贡献；令 j=−h，当 1≤h≤n 时得到关于 y=x⁻¹ 的有限多项式；h=n+1 只贡献常数 −1；更大的 h 没有贡献。因此整行由 Pₙ(y)=−1+∑ₕ₌₁ⁿ yʰ(1−yʰ)ⁿ⁻ʰ 编码，T(n,k) 就是 yᵏ 的系数。

把 (n+1)/2 的整数部分平方，所得数记为 Bₙ；超过它的系数全为零。n 为奇数时，逐项估计次数即可；n 为偶数时，还须将 h 与 n+1−h 配对，它们的最高次项幂次相同、符号相反，恰好抵消。例如 n=2 时，P₂(y)=−1+y(1−y)+y²=−1+y，所以完整一行是 −1、1，交替求和再取负得到 2。较小的行界来自抵消，而非任意截断。

交替相加多项式的系数，等于在 −1 处求值。这是在有限多项式中代入数值，并非在原来的无穷表达式中直接代入。奇数 h 的贡献是 −2ⁿ⁻ʰ；偶数 h 的贡献为零，唯有 h=n 时贡献 1。分别处理 n 的奇偶性，求几何级数便得 −Pₙ(−1)=2(2ⁿ−(−1)ⁿ)/3。Jacobsthal 数以 J₀=0、J₁=1 起始，满足 Jₙ₊₂=Jₙ₊₁+2Jₙ。它的已知通项表明，上式等于 2Jₙ。Jₙ 与 2ⁿ/3 恰好相差三分之一，小于二分之一，因此就是离它最近的整数。贡献在于建立它与 Hanna 系数的联系，而非发现新的 Jacobsthal 公式；行恒等式要求 n≥1。

逐项展开还能解释单个系数。第 h 项只有在 h 整除 k 时才可能含 yᵏ，其贡献是在 n−h 个对象中选 k/h−1 个的组合数，符号为 (−1)ᵏ⁄ʰ⁻¹；选择数超出范围时按零处理。对不超过 n 的约数 h 求和，便得到作者的系数公式，以及 Hanna 关于小列号、行末和素数位置系数的十个猜想公式。若 p 是奇素数，约数 1、p 各贡献 1，故 T(p,p)=2。若素数 q>n，只有约数 1 可用，而相应组合数为零，所以 T(n,q)=0。

同一多项式也给出其他求和关系。在 1 处求值得到行和为零。先求导再乘 y，会使每项系数乘上其列号；作用一次、两次后在 1 处求值，分别得到 ∑kT(n,k)=1 和 ∑k²T(n,k)=5−2n，后式要求 n≥2。只有含较低次 1−yʰ 因子的项能留下贡献。在 −1 处求导给出带列号权重的交替和。把这些数依次作为幂级数的系数，便得到它们的生成函数；再按 h 的奇偶性求几何级数，可将它写成两个多项式的比值。这些结论有书面论证，并非从样本行外推。

文稿报告了第1至79行的精确算术检查，并将 Jacobsthal 标量恒等式检查到 n=512。这些有限检查补充了适用于全部相应行的书面证明，却不能凭自身确立关于无限多行的结论。所附 Lean 源码快照涉及交替和定理、系数对应与支撑界、行和及前两个加权矩；约数公式、素数位置为零和交替加权生成函数并未由这些快照形式化。尤其，下一素数处为零，不等于它是首个零：对 n≥5，此前每项都非零的断言在本文中仍未解决，虽与第5至79行的检查一致。Hanna 评论中的另外两个双向恒等式也不在范围内。本文以一个有限多项式统一解释多项猜想，同时保留首个零位置这一未决问题。

works.title: Proof of Arkadeep Dutta's edge-collision ratio conjecture (OEIS A396659)
works.abstract: We prove the conjecture in Arkadeep Dutta's OEIS A396659, revision 16, FORMULA, third statement: T(n,n^2)/T(n,n^2+1)=(2n-1)/n for every n>=2. Here T(n,k) counts length-k walks from a fixed vertex of the complete looped directed graph on n labeled vertices, visiting every vertex and repeating an edge for the first time at step k. An omitted-edge classification and marked loop insertion prove the ratio. We also establish the entry's two companion formulas, T(n,n+1)=n! and T(n,n^2+1)=(n!)^n, with the linear-walk normalization explicit.
works.summary: A self-contained proof of Dutta's edge-collision ratio conjecture, together with complete proofs of both companion formulas in the same OEIS entry and exact finite checks of the counting bijections.

problems.name: Arkadeep Dutta's edge-collision ratio conjecture in OEIS A396659, revision 16, FORMULA, third statement

plain_language.en:
This paper counts walks among labeled vertices that visit every vertex and stop exactly when a directed edge is repeated for the first time, allowing loops at each vertex. It proves Dutta’s conjectured ratio between the counts at the two latest possible stopping times. Classifying the omitted edge and inserting a distinguished loop also establishes the two companion counting formulas.

Suppose you move among n labeled places, with a directed connection from every place to every place, including itself. How many routes visit every place and first reuse a connection at a specified step? Repeating a connection means repeating an ordered pair of consecutive places, not merely revisiting a place. The manuscript calls the count T(n,k), where k counts steps and the starting place is fixed. These connections form a complete directed graph with loops. Routes are ordered vertex lists, without identifying cyclic rotations, reversals, or relabelings. These conventions matter for the answers.

Haobo Ma and Wenlin Zhang establish Arkadeep Dutta’s conjecture in revision 16 of OEIS A396659: T(n,n²)/T(n,n²+1) = (2n−1)/n for n ≥ 2. They also prove T(n,n+1) = n! and T(n,n²+1) = (n!)ⁿ for n ≥ 1; n! counts permutations of n labels. With two places A and B, the routes using all four connections exactly once, starting at A, are A,A,B,B,A and A,B,B,A,A. Each allows either outgoing connection from A as a repeating fifth step, giving T(2,5) = 4. The corresponding fourth-step count is six.

There are only n² connections, so the ratio concerns the latest two possible first-repeat times. A route without repeated connections is called a trail. A trail using n²−1 connections omits exactly one and necessarily visits every place. At each vertex, departures balance arrivals except for one excess departure at the start and one excess arrival at the endpoint. Comparing this balance with the omitted connection leaves two disjoint possibilities: that connection goes from the endpoint back to the start, or it is a loop elsewhere and the trail ends at the start.

Write E for the number of trails using every connection once from the fixed start. Balance makes these closed routes, called Eulerian circuits. Appending the missing connection bijectively matches the first kind of trail with these circuits. For a missing loop at a nonstarting vertex a, write Lₐ for the trail count. Each trail has n−1 loop-insertion positions, one before each departure from a. Insertion gives a circuit; deletion recovers both trail and marked position. Thus (n−1)Lₐ = E. Summing over the n−1 eligible vertices gives a total E for the second kind. The two kinds allow respectively n−1 and n repeating next connections. Hence T(n,n²) = (n−1)E+nE, whereas T(n,n²+1) = nE.

To count E and establish positivity, the authors use the classical last-exit-tree construction associated with the BEST theorem, crediting van Aardenne-Ehrenfest and de Bruijn. Retain a circuit’s last departure from every vertex except the start. These edges form a tree pointing toward the start: a cycle would force last-departure times to increase around it. Conversely, choose such a tree and order outgoing connections, placing each tree connection last. Balance allows the route to stop only at its start. These orders exhaust all connections: otherwise unused departures force an unused tree connection and then unused departures along the parent chain to the already exhausted start. For n ≥ 2, Prüfer’s correspondence counts the trees by words of length n−2, giving nⁿ⁻² trees. There are n! outgoing orders at the start and (n−1)! elsewhere; multiplication gives nE = (n!)ⁿ.

The shorter companion formula uses another argument. Before a first repeat at step n+1, the prefix has n+1 vertex occurrences covering n vertices. Its single extra occurrence must be the final vertex, because the next connection repeats an earlier departure. Thus its first n entries permute the vertices, beginning at the fixed start. Choose that permutation in (n−1)! ways and the repeated vertex in n ways; the last connection is forced. These choices work because the first n departures have distinct tails. This gives n!. For n=1, the sole loop directly gives both companion formulas.

The advance over Dutta’s conjecture rests on reversible constructions, not extrapolation. Finite checks reproduce rows for n=1 through 4, test the bijections for n=2,3, and separately check trees through n=6. These are not all-input proofs. The manuscript reports pinned Lean evidence for the ratio and positivity under its formal walk hypotheses, not the factorial companions. Written arguments supply all three general results. The key insight is the exact balance between the omitted-edge classes. The scope remains this labeled, looped, complete directed graph with a fixed linear start; the note states no further open problem or generalization to other graphs.
plain_language.zh:
这篇论文计数一类在带标号顶点间行走的路径：允许自环，须访问所有顶点，并恰在首次重复使用一条有向边时停止。作者证明了杜塔关于最晚两个可能停止时刻所对应计数之比的猜想。通过分类尚未使用的边并插入一个带标记的自环，还证明了两条配套计数公式。

设有 n 个带标签的地点，每个地点都有一条有向连接通往任一地点，包括自身。多少条路线能走遍所有地点，并恰在指定步数首次重复一条连接？重复的是相邻地点构成的有序对，不是单纯重访地点。作者以 T(n,k) 表示固定起点、走 k 步的这类路线数。这就是带自环的完全有向图。路线按顶点序列计数，不把循环移位、反向或重标号视为等同；这些约定影响答案。

Haobo Ma 和 Wenlin Zhang 证明了 Arkadeep Dutta 在 OEIS A396659 第16版提出的猜想：n ≥ 2 时，T(n,n²)/T(n,n²+1) = (2n−1)/n。他们还证明，n ≥ 1 时，T(n,n+1) = n!，T(n,n²+1) = (n!)ⁿ；n! 是 n 个标签的排列数。两点 A、B 的例子中，从 A 出发恰用完四条连接的路线只有 A,A,B,B,A 和 A,B,B,A,A。各自接上 A 的任一出边，就得到四条在第五步首次重复的路线；第四步的对应计数为六。

总共只有 n² 条连接，比值涉及首次重复最晚发生的两个时刻。不重复边的路线称为迹。用了 n²−1 条边的迹恰漏一条边，且已访问全部顶点。各点的离开与到达次数平衡，只有起点多离开一次、终点多到达一次；起终点相同时抵消。与漏边的差额比较，只剩两个互斥情形：漏边从终点指回起点；或漏边是非起点的自环，此时迹回到起点。

记 E 为固定起点、每边恰用一次的迹数；平衡说明它们闭合，称为欧拉回路。第一类迹补上漏边就与回路一一对应。记 Lₐ 为漏掉非起点 a 的自环的迹数。每条迹在 a 有 n−1 次离开，也就有 n−1 个插入自环的位置。插入得到回路，删除则恢复迹及标记位置，故 (n−1)Lₐ = E。对 n−1 个可选顶点求和，第二类迹总数也为 E。两类迹分别有 n−1 条、n 条已用出边可供重复，故 T(n,n²) = (n−1)E+nE；完整回路则给出 T(n,n²+1) = nE。

为求 E 并证明其为正，作者采用 BEST 定理的经典“最后离开”树构造，归功于 van Aardenne-Ehrenfest 与 de Bruijn。保留回路在各非起点的最后一条出边，便得到指向起点的树：若有环，最后离开时间须沿环严格递增，不可能成立。反过来，选树并排列各点出边，把树边放在最后，依次走。次数平衡保证只能停在起点，而且必能用完全部边：否则，剩余出边迫使树边未用，沿父节点链最终迫使已耗尽出边的起点也有剩余，矛盾。n ≥ 2 时，Prüfer 对应用长度 n−2 的标签词计树，得 nⁿ⁻² 棵；起点有 n! 种出边顺序，其余各有 (n−1)! 种，相乘得 nE = (n!)ⁿ。

较短的公式另证。第 n+1 步首次重复时，此前有 n+1 次顶点出现，覆盖 n 个顶点，恰多一次。下一步要重复先前的离开，故多出的出现必在前缀末端。前 n 项于是为固定起点开头的顶点排列，有 (n−1)! 种；末端重复哪个顶点有 n 种选择，最后一条边随即确定。这样选择确实可行，因为前 n 次离开的起点互不相同，故总数为 n!。n=1 时，唯一的自环直接给出两个伴随公式。

相较于 Dutta 的猜想，作者的推进依靠可逆构造而非外推。有限检查重现 n=1 至4的各行，在 n=2、3 检查对应，另将树的检查做到 n=6；这些不是全体输入的证明。文稿报告，固定版本的 Lean 证据在其形式化路线假设下证明比值及分母为正，不涵盖阶乘公式。三个一般结论依靠书面论证。关键是两类漏边迹的精确数量平衡；范围限于带标签、带自环的完全有向图及固定线性起点。文稿未提出后续开放问题，也未声称推广到其他图。

works.title: Resolving User3's orthogonal absolute-product question: minimum and minimizers
works.abstract: We resolve User3's question (question 515549, revision 1, September 25, 2026): for every nonsingular real square matrix of positive size, the orthogonal minimum of rho(|PQ||Q^T P^{-1}|) is attained and equals one. Thus the proposed strict uniform lower bound cannot hold for any such matrix. We give a self-contained exposition of the triangularization proof in the pinned formal source, then characterize every minimizer by independent row and column permutations to triangular form. For fixed P, the set of minimizers is finite and has an explicit description using row-permuted QR factorizations. The same minimum holds over the special orthogonal group. Finally, the companion absolute-row-sum balancing question follows from the Yamabe-Yujobo theorem.
works.summary: The triangularization proof settles both questions in MathOverflow 515549. Complete equality-case and finite-minimizer descriptions strengthen that result; the Yamabe-Yujobo sphere theorem settles the same author's companion question 515547. The pinned Lean declaration result states the universal lower bound and orthogonal attainment. Equality cases, the special-orthogonal refinement and balancing have written proofs; exact rational controls cover the enumerated finite cases.

problems.name: User3's orthogonal absolute-product minimum question, MathOverflow 515549

plain_language.en:
This paper asks how small a certain measure of matrix growth can become when the columns of an invertible real matrix are rotated: the largest eigenvalue magnitude of the product of the entrywise absolute values of the rotated matrix and its inverse. It proves that the minimum is always attained and equals one, and characterizes every optimal rotation through triangular matrix forms.

Take an invertible real square matrix P and choose an orthogonal matrix Q, a change of coordinates preserving lengths and angles. Set A = PQ. Multiplying A by its inverse gives the identity, but what happens if every entry of both matrices is first replaced by its absolute value? Cancellation disappears. How small can the resulting product’s spectral radius—the largest absolute value of its eigenvalues—be as Q varies? User3 asked whether some P could keep it uniformly above one. Haobo Ma and Wenlin Zhang establish that, in every positive dimension, the minimum is exactly one and is attained.

The lower bound follows from the inverse relation. The triangle inequality makes the absolute-value product at least the identity entry by entry. Its diagonal sum is therefore at least the dimension; because this also equals the sum of its eigenvalues, its spectral radius is at least one. To attain one, orthogonalize P’s rows in order: subtract components along preceding directions, then normalize. Invertibility prevents zero residuals. Taking these directions as Q’s columns makes PQ lower triangular. Its inverse is also lower triangular, and their absolute-value product has diagonal entries one, so all eigenvalues are one. Column sign changes preserve the objective and allow Q to have determinant one.

The authors also characterize every equality case: an invertible A gives spectral radius one exactly when independently reordering its rows and columns makes it triangular. Equality forces all eigenvalues of the absolute-value product to be one. Subtracting the identity leaves a nonnegative matrix whose sufficiently high powers vanish. Regard positive entries as directed arrows: a cycle would produce positive entries in arbitrarily high powers, so no cycle exists. Ordering this graph makes the product triangular. Its zero entries force corresponding zeros in A, while its diagonal supplies distinct column choices, yielding the claimed arrangement. Thus every minimizing Q comes from orthogonalizing some ordering of P’s rows, then permuting and changing signs of the directions. In dimension K there are at most 2ᴷ(K!)² minimizers, with possible repetitions in this description.

Spectral radius one does not mean the product is the identity. For the triangular matrix with rows (1, 0) and (1, 1), the inverse has rows (1, 0) and (−1, 1). Their absolute-value product has rows (1, 0) and (2, 1): it is not diagonalizable, yet both eigenvalues are one. The authors connect this spectral quantity with Rump’s earlier results on positive row and column scaling. It equals the infimum of the scaled matrix’s condition number, defined here using the maximum absolute row-sum norm and the same norm of its inverse. Such scaling may only approach its infimum, unlike the attained orthogonal minimum.

A companion question asks whether an orthogonal transformation can make all absolute row sums of the inverse factor equal. The authors answer yes for every invertible L, without requiring triangularity. They apply Yamabe and Yujobo’s 1950 theorem: a continuous real-valued function on a sphere takes equal values on some orthonormal basis. Here the function sends a unit direction to the sum of absolute entries obtained by multiplying it by L’s inverse. Continuity and invertibility give a common positive value. Sign changes again permit determinant one.

However, balancing and minimizing need not use the same Q. Take P = L with diagonal entries one and two. Every two-dimensional orthogonal Q has absolute-value rows (a, b) and (b, a), with a, b nonnegative and a² + b² = 1. Equal inverse-factor row sums force a = b = 1/√2. Every such balancing choice gives spectral radius two, not one. Thus exact balancing also answers the weaker approximate-balancing question, but cannot generally be combined with spectral minimization.

The authors credit the main triangularization argument to a pinned Lean source from The Omega Institute, reported to establish the universal lower bound and orthogonal attainment. The note provides written proofs; its equality classification, determinant-one refinement and balancing result are not claimed as covered by that Lean theorem. The README describes finite rational checks: exhaustive invertible two-by-two integer matrices with entries from −2 to 2, selected three- and four-dimensional cases, and constructed examples through dimension eight. These checks are not universal proofs, and no execution results are supplied here. The contribution is an attained minimum and finite, explicit classification for all invertible real square matrices. No further open problem is formulated; simultaneous balancing is specifically obstructed by the example.
plain_language.zh:
这篇论文研究：对可逆实矩阵的列作正交变换后，将所得矩阵及其逆矩阵分别逐项取绝对值，再相乘，所得矩阵的最大特征值模能有多小。作者证明，对每个这样的矩阵，最小值都能取到且等于一，并借助三角矩阵形式刻画了所有达到最小值的正交变换。

给定可逆实方阵 P，选择保持长度和角度的正交矩阵 Q，令 A = PQ。A 与逆矩阵相乘本应得到单位矩阵；但若先把两者的每个元素取绝对值，正负抵消就消失了。所得乘积的谱半径，即特征值绝对值的最大值，随 Q 改变能小到多少？User3 问过，是否有某些 P，使它对所有 Q 都一致大于一。Haobo Ma 与 Wenlin Zhang 证明：任意正维数、任意可逆实方阵，最小值都恰为一，而且能够达到。

下界来自逆矩阵关系。三角不等式说明，绝对值乘积逐项不小于单位矩阵，故对角线之和至少等于维数。这个和也等于特征值之和，因此谱半径至少为一。要达到一，就依次将 P 的各行减去沿先前方向的分量，再归一化；可逆性保证不会得到零向量。把所得方向作为 Q 的列，PQ 就成为下三角矩阵。其逆矩阵也下三角，两者的绝对值乘积对角元全为一，故特征值全是一。列变号不影响目标值，还能使 Q 的行列式为一。

作者还刻画全部等号情形：可逆 A 的上述乘积谱半径为一，当且仅当分别重排行和列后，A 能成为三角矩阵。等号迫使乘积的所有特征值为一；减去单位矩阵后，得到非负矩阵，其足够高次幂为零。把正元素看作有向箭头：若有环，就会在任意高次幂中反复产生正元素，造成矛盾。因此可按无环结构排序，使乘积成为三角矩阵。乘积的零迫使 A 出现相应的零，对角线则提供互不重复的列选择，完成三角排列。全部最优 Q 因而都来自某种行排序的正交化，再将所得方向换序、变号。维数为 K 时，至多有 2ᴷ(K!)² 个最优解，描述中可能重复。

谱半径为一不代表乘积是单位矩阵。例如，两行为 (1, 0)、(1, 1) 的三角矩阵，其逆矩阵两行为 (1, 0)、(−1, 1)，绝对值乘积两行为 (1, 0)、(2, 1)。后者不能对角化，但两个特征值都是一。作者还联系 Rump 关于正数缩放行、列的既有结果：这个谱量等于缩放后条件数的下确界；这里条件数是矩阵与其逆矩阵的最大绝对行和范数之积。与正交优化不同，缩放可能只能逼近下确界，不能达到。

相关的另一问题是：能否选择正交变换，让逆矩阵因子的各行绝对值之和相等？作者对任意可逆 L 给出肯定答案，不要求三角性。他们应用 Yamabe 与 Yujobo 在1950年的定理：球面上的连续实函数，总能在某组正交单位基上取相同值。这里，函数把单位方向映为该方向乘以 L 的逆矩阵后，各分量绝对值之和。连续性与可逆性给出共同的正值；方向变号又能使行列式为一。

不过，平衡与最优化未必能使用同一个 Q。令 P = L 为对角元一、二的二维对角矩阵。任意正交 Q 的绝对值矩阵都可写成两行 (a, b)、(b, a)，其中 a、b 非负且 a² + b² = 1。逆矩阵因子的行和相等要求 a = b = 1/√2，而所有这类选择都使谱半径为二，并非一。因此精确平衡也回答了较弱的近似平衡问题，却不能一般地兼顾谱优化。

作者将主要三角化论证归功于 The Omega Institute 的固定版本 Lean 源码；据文稿说明，它覆盖普遍下界与正交取到最小值。本文提供书面证明，未声称等号分类、行列式为一的推广及平衡结论也由该 Lean 定理覆盖。README 描述的有限有理算术检查包括：穷举元素在 −2 至 2 之间的可逆二阶整数矩阵，部分三、四维情形，以及一至八维构造例子。这些不是普遍证明，所给材料也没有执行结果。本文的意义是对全部可逆实方阵给出可达到的最小值和有限、明确的完整最优解描述；未另列开放问题，而同时平衡与最优化已在例子中受到明确阻碍。

works.title: Counterexamples to Wang's Conjectures 3.26 and 5.3 on semigroup algebras
works.abstract: We refute Conjectures 3.26 and 5.3 of Wang's Semigroup rings and algebraically independent sequences with respect to idempotents in commutative semigroups (arXiv:2509.18724v1, pp. 23 and 27). The commutative periodic monoid of finite subsets of the natural numbers, paired with levels zero, one and two under union and capped addition, has algebraic Davenport constant one over every nonzero commutative unitary ring. Its nongroup relative Davenport constants are unbounded. The finite submonoids with supports contained in {1,...,m}, m>=1, have the same algebraic constant, whereas the expression conjectured to equal it grows without bound as m increases.
works.summary: One fixed infinite periodic monoid refutes Conjecture 3.26. Its finite submonoids refute Conjecture 5.3, already with six elements; all relative constants are computed exactly.

problems.name: Wang's Conjecture 3.26 on semigroup rings and relative Davenport constants
Wang's Conjecture 5.3 on finite semigroup rings

plain_language.en:
This paper tests two proposed formulas connecting a sequence invariant defined through semigroup rings with other sequence-length invariants of the underlying commutative system. It constructs a system from finite subsets and a three-level counter where the algebraic invariant equals one but the nongroup relative invariants are unbounded. Finite versions also keep the algebraic invariant at one while the conjectured expression grows without bound.

When can algebraic cancellation control how long a sum needs to be? In an additive structure, a sequence is irreducible if deleting any nonempty selection of terms changes its sum. Guoqing Wang studied the longest such sequences with a prescribed sum and conjectured connections with nonvanishing products in an associated algebra. Haobo Ma and Wenlin Zhang separate these measurements: algebraic nonvanishing stops at length one, while irreducible sequences become arbitrarily long. The manuscript credits Daniel Smertnig with earlier discrepancies for finite groups; its counterexamples address Wang’s semigroup conjectures.

Their elements are pairs (A,k), where A is a finite subset of a set U and k is zero, one or two. Addition takes unions and adds levels, stopping at two. The empty set at level zero is the identity, making this a commutative monoid. Repeated addition eventually stabilizes, so it is periodic. Levels zero and two are unchanged by doubling: they are idempotents. A level-one element instead reaches its associated idempotent at level two after doubling. Its positive multiples form a two-element structure that is not a group: neither element acts as its identity.

For the algebraic measurement, choose any nonzero commutative coefficient ring R with identity. Give every monoid element a separate formal basis symbol, multiplying symbols by adding their labels; even an absorbing label remains a basis symbol, not algebraic zero. For each sequence term, subtract a nonzero scalar times its associated idempotent’s symbol from its own symbol, then multiply these differences. The algebraic Davenport constant d is the supremum of lengths for which this product stays nonzero for every choice of nonzero scalars. The authors prove d = 1 for every U and such R. Choosing every scalar to be one kills an idempotent factor immediately. Otherwise, two level-one differences multiply to zero: all four expanded terms have the same union support and level two, with coefficients cancelling. A single level-one difference remains nonzero because its labels are distinct.

The contrasting relative Davenport constant D at a target is the longest irreducible sequence summing to it. Empty subsequences count, with sum equal to the identity. The authors establish D at (A,k) = |A| + k, where |A| counts A’s points. For example, if U contains u, the terms ({u},0) and (∅,1) sum irreducibly to ({u},1): deleting either loses support or lowers the level. Nevertheless their algebraic product vanishes when both scalars are one. Additive indispensability need not survive as algebraic nonvanishing.

The lower bound generalizes that example: use one singleton-support level-zero term per point of A, together with k empty-support level-one terms. For the upper bound, mark at most k terms supplying the target level: none for level zero, the unique positive-level term for level one, or one level-two term or two level-one terms for level two. Deleting any unmarked term preserves the level. Irreducibility therefore requires it to carry a support point absent from every other term. These exclusive points are distinct, allowing at most |A| unmarked terms. The authors also compute the elements reachable by addition: supports can only enlarge and levels only increase. Distinct elements therefore generate distinct principal ideals. Consequently the Green quotient, which identifies equal principal ideals here, changes nothing, and the associated Schützenberger permutation groups on these singleton classes are trivial.

Taking U to be the natural numbers gives targets ({1,…,m},1) with relative constants m + 1 in one fixed monoid, despite d = 1. This refutes Wang’s Conjecture 3.26 about boundedness at elements whose positive multiples do not form groups. For finite U of size m ≥ 1, the monoid has 3·2^m elements. Its cyclic periods are one, so every field meets the splitting-field hypothesis in Wang’s Conjecture 5.3. That conjecture combines nongroup relative constants with algebraic constants of the associated groups. Those group contributions are zero here, leaving a predicted m + 1 instead of one. Already m = 1 gives a six-element counterexample.

The arbitrary-ring equality, exact relative formulas and finite counterexamples have written proofs. The manuscript describes an existing Lean source as formalizing the infinite refutation over the rational numbers, using the algebraic upper bound and unbounded relative constants—not all these extensions. Its finite checker covers support sizes zero, one and two and sequences through length m + 3; those tests do not establish the universal formulas. The result separates support-based irreducibility from algebraic cancellation, but supplies no replacement general characterization or globally smallest counterexample. It also does not contradict the companion remark’s literal wording about groups, only its semigroup interpretation.

这篇论文检验两个猜想，它们把通过半群环定义的序列不变量，与底层交换系统的其他序列长度不变量联系起来。作者用有限子集和三级计数构造出一个系统，其代数不变量等于一，非群相对不变量却无界。有限版本的代数不变量也始终为一，而猜想中应与之相等的表达式不断增长。

代数中的抵消能否控制一个和需要多少项？在加法结构中，若任何真子序列都不能保持原来的和，就称序列不可约。Guoqing Wang 研究了给定目标和的不可约序列能有多长，并猜想它与相关代数中乘积不为零的性质存在联系。Haobo Ma 和 Wenlin Zhang 构造的例子把两者分开：代数指标只有一，不可约序列却能任意长。文稿引用了 Smertnig 关于有限群的较早差异结果；这里的反例针对王氏的半群猜想。

构造中的元素是数对 (A,k)：A 是集合 U 的有限子集，k 取零、一、二。相加时，集合取并集，层数相加但最高只到二。空集配零是单位元，因此这是交换幺半群。反复相加最终稳定，故称周期的。零层和二层元素加自身不变，是幂等元；一层元素加自身则到达对应的二层幂等元。其正整数倍只有这两个元素，却不构成群，因为两者都不能充当这个两元素结构的单位元。

定义代数指标时，先选任意有单位元的非零交换环 R。给每个幺半群元素一个独立的形式基符号，符号相乘就是标签相加；即使标签是吸收元，也不把它当作代数中的零。对序列每项，用它的符号减去非零系数乘以对应幂等元的符号，再将这些差相乘。对所有非零系数选择都保持乘积非零的序列，其长度上确界就是代数 Davenport 常数 d。作者证明，对所有 U 和这样的 R 都有 d = 1。把系数全选为一，幂等元对应的因子立即为零；若全是一层元素，两个因子展开的四项标签相同，系数恰好抵消。单个一层因子却始终非零，因为两个基标签不同。

相对 Davenport 常数 D 则衡量目标和的不可约序列最长有多长。空子序列也算，其和是单位元。作者得到：目标 (A,k) 的 D = |A| + k，其中 |A| 是 A 的点数。例如 U 含一点 u 时，({u},0) 与 (∅,1) 不可约地加成 ({u},1)：删去前者丢失支撑点，删去后者降低层数。但系数都取一时，对应的代数乘积为零。这说明加法中不可缺少的项，在代数中仍可能抵消。

下界沿用这个例子：为 A 的每个点放一个零层单点项，再放 k 个空支撑一层项。上界则先标记至多 k 项来保证目标层数：零层不标记，一层标记唯一的正层项，二层标记一个二层项或两个一层项。删去任何未标记项都不改变层数，因此不可约性迫使它拥有其他项都没有的专属支撑点。不同未标记项的专属点不同，故至多有 |A| 项。作者还算出，加法只能扩大支撑、提高层数，所以不同元素生成不同的主理想，即由继续相加可到达的元素集合。于是这里按主理想相等作识别的 Green 商不改变结构，相关单元素类上的 Schützenberger 置换群也都是平凡群。

取 U 为自然数集，目标 ({1,…,m},1) 的相对常数为 m + 1。这在同一个幺半群中无界，而 d 始终为一，反驳了王氏猜想 3.26 对正倍数不成群的元素所提出的有界性结论。若 U 只有 m ≥ 1 个点，结构有 3·2^m 个元素。循环周期全为一，使每个域都满足猜想 5.3 的分裂域条件。该猜想把非群元素的相对常数与相关群的代数常数组合起来；这里群的贡献为零，预测值成为 m + 1，而实际为一。m = 1 就给出六元素反例。

任意环上的精确等式、全部相对公式和有限反例都有书面证明。文稿介绍的既有 Lean 源码只形式化了有理数上的无限反例，使用代数上界一及相对常数无界，并未覆盖全部推广。有限检查程序覆盖支撑大小零、一、二，以及长度至 m + 3 的序列；普遍公式不是由这些测试推出的。工作的意义在于分离支撑所保留的不可约性与代数抵消，但它没有给出新的普遍刻画，也未声称六元素反例全局最小。对附带评注，它仅反驳半群解释，不反驳原文按字面谈群的表述。
